name: Mushroom Kingdom waterworks
description: The existing bright Mushroom Kingdom artwork, rebuilt around a brick aperture, isolated wooden river landings, a moving ferry and a solid tower with a bent pipe.
alignmentNote: Foreground traced from the finished Mario Adventure painting; solid riverbanks, masonry aperture, tower and pipe; thin wooden platforms are pass-through.

name: Mute City Grand Prix
description: F-Zero: gigantic futuristic racing pit complex, glowing cyan maglev lanes, layered banked race tracks, blue and gold racing-machine silhouettes parked deep in the background, precision metal catwalks, hangar service gantries, distant neon city at night, hazard stripes and luminous engine cores. Speedway energy and depth, blue / cyan / hot pink. No readable billboards.

name: Inside the Great Deku Tree
description: Zelda Ocarina of Time: hollow ancient tree with enormous central trunk, spiral roots, Kokiri wooden balconies and rope bridges, ivy, mushrooms, dappled emerald light, carved forest emblems, tiny warm fairy lights, woven rope bindings, bark knots, moss. A magical forest village built around a living tree; no stone castle.

name: Kongo jungle treetops
description: Donkey Kong Country: lush layered tropical rainforest, huge gnarled trees, rope suspension walkways, detailed weathered wooden barrel staves, bananas tucked in background foliage, waterfalls, crumbling vine-covered jungle temples, sunbeams through canopy, rustic banana-hoard cabin behind a platform. Warm timber and vivid deep greens, sculpted rocks, no generic floating Mario blocks.

name: Capsule Clinic — machinery chambers
description: Sharp illustrated laboratory architecture: solid receiving dock and vial cabinet, central chromatography column, open-sided test chamber, small access platforms and uncovered shafts.

name: Corneria skyline
description: Star Fox: towering Cornerian city rooftops at sunset, layered blue-gray skyscrapers, antenna forests, open-air aerial transit rails, distant Arwing-like ships, rooftop machinery, titanium maintenance balconies, glass facades catching orange sunset, a capital ship far behind the city. Cinematic industrial architecture with strong height and depth, not another orbital hangar.

name: Great Fox orbital hangar
description: Star Fox: cross-section of the Great Fox mothership hangar, huge open bay with starfield and curved blue planet, Arwing spacecraft parked behind the playing area, ribbed metal bulkheads, cargo lifts, consoles, gantries, warning-light strips, glass control-room gallery, brushed titanium and blue-orange lights. Dense spacecraft detailing, clean readable foreground deck edges.

name: Infinite iceberg ascent
description: Ice Climber: a soaring glacier summit, translucent blue ice slabs with trapped bubbles and cracks, thick snow caps, rope climbing pegs, aurora-filled polar sky, far snowy mountains, tiny distant condor, icicles behind the route, ice-cave mouth at the base. Distinct arctic identity, crisp cool cyan and lilac with bright snowy highlights.

name: Fountain of Dreams garden
description: Kirby Dream Land: fantastical Fountain of Dreams among pastel cloud islands, iridescent round pearl columns, sculpted golden star crests, mirrored lavender water in background, curled candy-pink trees, flower gardens, glittering night aurora and crescent moons. Plush / pearlescent materials and whimsical stars, fairy-tale dream garden, very different from ordinary grassy Mario terrain.
alignmentNote: Painted main floor and upper ledge alignment calibrated against the native collision overlay.

name: Bowser molten keep
description: Bowser castle: monumental volcanic fortress, gigantic carved horned turtle stone faces, wrought iron chains, bronze spiked battlements, ornate black stone bridges, red banners with shell motif, lava streams far in the background, glowing furnace grilles and massive throne. Dark basalt with hot gold/red illumination, detailed carved masonry, luminous readable edges.
alignmentNote: Separate solid islands, basalt ceilings, central wall and small pass-through iron platforms; native lava follows the painted lake surface.

name: Forest Temple ruins
description: Zelda Ocarina of Time Forest Temple: ancient overgrown stone sanctuary, carved mossy towers, relief triangles, vines, broken marble stairs, sacred forest behind colonnades, stained emerald glass, ornate bronze braziers, deep moss and golden sunlight. Raised central ruin altar, asymmetrical ivy, engraved Hylian-like abstract ornament without text. Distinct mature stone architecture.

name: Altea castle ramparts
description: Fire Emblem Altea: noble blue-and-silver medieval fortress, sculpted marble ramparts, carved lion crests, royal blue embroidered banners, wrought silver gates, elegant cathedral towers and blue tiled turrets beyond, sword reliefs, moonstone balconies, lush distant plains. Regal cool daylight, exquisite blue/gold ornament, strong stone engineering.

name: Cinnabar genetic containment
description: Pokemon Mewtwo: abandoned secret cloning laboratory, central violet stasis capsule, shattered green glass tanks, old research consoles, twisted cables, thick pipes, psychic energy lighting in the background, cracked tiled floors and caution strips, dramatic lilac mist. Tense scientific ruin with subtle Pokemon laboratory motifs, no character in the foreground.

name: Onett after school
description: EarthBound: warm small-town Onett streets, colourful suburban houses and shop awnings, red-brick school, wooden fences, telephone poles with wires, parked retro yellow bus in background, baseball objects, striped burger-shop awning, grassy yards, charming painted clouds. Miniature clay-like buildings with hand-painted detail, bright Americana, no generic fantasy castle.

name: Peach royal conservatory
description: Princess Peach castle: elegant rose garden and glass conservatory, cream marble balustrades, pink satin banners with crown crest, rose-covered arches, carved shell fountain, topiary, pearl-gold fittings, distant pink-roofed Mushroom Kingdom castle, ornate wrought-iron plant stands. Bright romantic ivory, rose and sage. Platforms become garden terraces and fountain ledges.
alignmentNote: Painted main floor and upper ledge alignment calibrated against the native collision overlay.

name: Pichu electrical workshop
description: Pokemon Pichu: cheerful tiny repair workshop seen from a small creature perspective, oversized brass battery cells, ceramic insulators, coiled wires, miniature workbenches, spools, screws, wooden instrument cabinets, colourful rounded electrical meters and toy-like lightning motifs. Warm honey yellow with turquoise, richly detailed tactile materials, gentle sparks only in background.

name: Pokemon power station
description: Pokemon Pikachu: immense industrial power station, central cylindrical generator tower, copper coils, heavy ceramic insulators, glass lightning tubes, yellow hazard rails, layered steel servicing balconies, overhead power cables, cyan electrical glow and warm yellow highlights. Convincing full-scale machinery, huge sense of scale, distinct from Pichu cosy workshop.

name: Moonlit Pokemon recital
description: Pokemon Jigglypuff: celestial open-air music recital above the clouds, spiralling pearl stage platforms, crescent moon ornaments, velvet rose drapes far behind, gold music-note carvings, starlit indigo sky, sparkling soft clouds, tiny microphone and curved stage rigging as background scenery. Dreamy musical storybook atmosphere with lavender, blush and silver, not Kirby star fountain.

name: Zebes Chozo depths
description: Metroid Super Metroid: alien cavern cutaway through Zebes, ancient engraved Chozo stone ruins fused with organic green rock and strange machinery, glowing cyan door rims in rear walls, amber crystal veins, ribbed rock ledges, biomechanical pipes, phosphorescent moss, mysterious carved bird statues. Teal/amber sci-fi cave lighting, dense material detail, layered deep caverns.

name: Kakariko Shadow Temple
description: Zelda Sheik: tall secret Shadow Temple training shaft, weathered dark wood and carved purple stone, eye emblems, hanging cloth strips, rope pulleys, shoji-like lattice screens, ancient Sheikah symbols without text, concealed doorways, pale violet torchlight and mist. Nimble ninja route through a sinister vertical shrine, tactile stone and cloth.

name: Yoshi story pop-up island
description: Yoshi Story: handmade storybook island, patchwork fabric hills, stitched felt leaves, knitted moss, cardboard cliffs with crayon texture, oversized spotted eggs in background nests, colourful bead flowers, fabric clouds. Sophisticated tactile crafted materials, lush pastel greens/coral/sky blue, charming rounded forms, exact straight walkable boundaries retained.
alignmentNote: Painted main floor and upper ledge alignment calibrated against the native collision overlay.

name: Temple of Time sanctuary
description: Zelda Temple of Time: luminous monumental ivory cathedral, ornate pale sandstone columns, jewel-coloured stained glass, sacred gold triangle motifs, blue-and-gold carpets behind the platforms, carved sun reliefs, shafts of warm white light, distant elevated altar and stone arches. Serene regal magic and intricately carved stone, distinct from Link forest and Sheik shadow.
alignmentNote: Calibrated the painted marble floor and top balcony against their native collision heights.

name: Game and Watch tabletop
description: Mr. Game & Watch: a vintage handheld electronic game viewed straight-on, entire level INSIDE one sharply detailed gray-green LCD screen, precise black and muted translucent LCD segments form Fire/Manhole/Donkey Kong-inspired scaffolds and ladders, embossed dark bezel at outer edges, tiny screw heads and brushed metal reflections. Authentic restricted LCD palette and graphic silhouettes; visual richness comes from real screen texture, faint inactive segments and hardware detail. NO coloured fantasy landscape and no readable labels.

name: Pherae burning battlements
description: Fire Emblem Roy: red-and-gold medieval fortress above a volcanic valley, flame-emblem banners, warm sandstone ramparts, charred siege beams, glowing brazier niches, wrought iron, embroidered crimson pennants, weathered red roof tiles, distant blazing sunset over an army camp. Heroic warm lighting, ember glints, more rugged and fiery than Marth blue Altea.
alignmentNote: Painted main floor and upper ledge alignment calibrated against the native collision overlay.

name: Dark Citadel
description: Ganondorf’s shattered castle: black gothic masonry, moonlit stone lips, crimson banners and a deep violet-green abyss. Two isolated foundations, pass-through balconies, a suspended solid bastion and a moving broken bridge.
